answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital island of integrity in an economy of AI agents, requiring participants to lock capital to validate transactions. Much like a quill marking a ledger, each signature provides proof of ownership, forcing an attacker to accumulate massive wealth to compromise the horizon of network security. The cost is high, as an adversary must purchase a majority of the circulating supply, rendering the financial penalty for a Sybil attack prohibitive and economically irrational.
